frames.heading: Ozzy
frames.body: Whoa, we haven't vibed that hard since before the uprising!

frames.heading: Zapp
frames.body: Let's head to Beebop Boulevard, the center of Funktopolis. They will help us there!

frames.heading: Moxie
frames.body: Welcome to Beebop Boulevard, it's a pleasure to meet you!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: I'd recognise that hair anywhere! Did you go to the Intergalactic School of Music?

frames.heading: Moxie
frames.body: Mojo, I haven't seen you in years! You seem... different.

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Ever since arriving at this place, my mojo has gone! But enough about me. We've come to defeat the Grand Composer, and save your planet!

frames.heading: Moxie
frames.body: I'm afraid you're too late, the Grand Composer is almost finished with his new planet. Silence will soon spread across the whole Universe.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Moxie, is there anything you can do to help us?

frames.heading: Moxie
frames.body: Well, I have the old Celestial Amp, but it hasn't been used since the Uprising... If you can free our planet, I will entrust the Amp to you.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Perfect! We will use the Amp to free Funkopolis from its silent prison. Let's rock!!!
